messages:
sophie.carter: Quick sync — CardeaSystems renewal is coming up late April and they asked for a 90-min hands-on enablement workshop (engineers + platform folks). Need to lock date + facilitator. Proposed slots: 2026-04-12 10:00 PT, 2026-04-14 14:00 PT, 2026-04-16 09:00 PT. React with :one:/:two:/:three: or drop availability.
jake.liu: I can do one of these. Prefer 4/14 (afternoon PT) so it's friendly for EU folks. I can cover Dedicated migration and cost controls.
maria.gomez: i'll own invites + lab orchestration. Are we using the standard hands-on terraform lab or the private VPC runbook? Link to template: https://docs.redwood.com/playbooks/hands-on-lab
alex.roberts: Cardea's infra team wants the private deployment walkthrough + a CLI lab where they actually push config. They prefer after 10am ET. Option 2 (4/14 14:00 PT) maps to 17:00 ET — that's OK.
priya.nair: Heads up — account health check flagged a medium renewal risk (notes: "migration friction, unclear rollback plan"). We should add a pre-lab checklist and an explicit fallback/canary section.
deploy-bot: Draft calendar events created (private): https://calendar.redwood.com/drafts/ABCD-1234 — please review and approve.
sophie.carter: Thanks. Maria can you draft a 90-min agenda? Quick suggested skeleton below (feel free to tweak):

maria.gomez: Draft agenda created here: https://docs.redwood.com/enablement/cardea-2026-draft — added pre-reqs + lab instructions. I'll post feedback form link after we finalize.

sophie.carter: Suggested agenda (short):
```
00:00 - Welcome, goals, success criteria (10m)
10:00 - Cardea architecture + migration concerns (15m)
25:00 - Demo: Dedicated -> private deployment (20m)
45:00 - Guided hands-on lab (30m)
75:00 - Fallbacks, canary pattern, runbook review (10m)
85:00 - Feedback + next steps (5-10m)
```

jake.liu: Add a short segment in the demo to show KV-cache behavior and quantization tradeoffs. Also :two: from me for date.
priya.nair: I'll coordinate with account exec to mark this as high-touch. Maria — can you add a short pre-session checklist we can send to Cardea (SSH keys, billing sandbox access, expected attendees)?
maria.gomez: Yep — pulled checklist into the doc and added a short Google form for feedback: https://forms.gle/feedback-cardea
alex.roberts: Cardea confirmed they prefer 4/14 14:00 PT. They'll bring 3 infra engineers + 1 product owner. Please include instructions to provision test VPC ahead of time.
sophie.carter: Great — plan: lock 4/14 14:00 PT, Maria to send invite + pre-reqs by EOD, Jake to own demo, Priya to handle account exec liaison. Maria please assign "facilitator" tag in the invite and add the feedback form link.
maria.gomez: On it — will send the invite with lab SSH creds and feedback form. Also adding a short post-workshop follow-up template for CS -> Sales handoff.
priya.nair: I'll flag renewal as "action: workshop scheduled" in the CRM and request a health-check follow-up two weeks after.
sophie.carter: Perfect. If no objections I'll finalize the invite at 18:00 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alex.roberts: All good from Cardea side, thanks!
notes: workflow: enablement scheduling, renewal-risk mitigation, pre-lab checklist, feedback capture
